epics.title: Drops, Buildcraft, Store, and Player Info
Warp Sector Ending and Full Game Integration

tasks.title: Build the repair station and randomized store
tasks.description: Create the station interaction and paused shop UI, generate three offers from YARD categories, and implement purchases, slot checks, refunds on install failure, and hull repair. Verify new eligible YARD entries can appear without editing the shop script.

tasks.title: Build the sensor component
tasks.description: Refresh sensor contacts periodically using wrapped distance, and update the caravan’s known location only when sensors encounter it. Verify a Long-Range Scanner extends contact discovery.

tasks.title: Verify sector-edge combat wrapping
tasks.description: Test enemy targeting across opposite sector edges and correct gameplay distances that do not use SectorSpace.shortest_delta().

tasks.title: Add shield boosters and rare module drops
tasks.description: Build both pickup scenes/scripts, add enemy drop rolls, and assign the scenes to enemy variants. Verify kills award credits, shield boosters drop occasionally, and rare modules install only when a slot is free.

tasks.title: Add the shield shader
tasks.description: Connect the shield shader to ship visuals and make its appearance respond to shield health, disappearing near zero.

tasks.title: Build the shader-driven space background
tasks.description: Implement starfield and nebula shaders, the background scene, and parallax/evolution behavior. Verify layers move at different rates and have no collision or gameplay logic.

tasks.title: Create a dedicated shader lab
tasks.description: Build a runnable ShaderLab scene for quickly previewing and iterating on shaders.

tasks.title: Build enemy ships and AI variants
tasks.description: Create the shared enemy scene/script, explosion, and Corsair/Cutter variants. Configure YARD IDs, collision/team rules, toroidal aggro, firing, patrol alerts, and one-time bounty rewards. Verify enemies stay passive outside aggro range and engage/fire correctly.

tasks.title: Build patrol groups
tasks.description: Create the patrol group scene/script and configure three ships to share an alert. Verify that one member detecting the player alerts the others, including members just outside their individual detection range.

tasks.title: Build the persistent outpost objective
tasks.description: Create the Lit outpost, attack and destruction behavior, persistent alert/destruction state, and explosion. Verify it remains represented as the main objective outside sensor range and stays destroyed after sector reload.

tasks.title: Build the world-state caravan
tasks.description: Create the caravan from patrol ships, configure its drift and escorts, and make it appear only in the sector selected by world state—not from a combat wave.

tasks.title: Create projectiles and basic combat
tasks.description: Build projectile scenes and collision/team filtering; verify forward fire, damage, shields, hull, and death behavior.

tasks.title: Prove the pilot-system idea
tasks.description: Verify the YARD-selected pilot ability changes player movement independently of the ship definition.

tasks.title: Create the project structure
tasks.description: Create the folder and asset structure so later scenes, scripts, registries, and resources have consistent homes.

tasks.title: Project settings and input map
tasks.description: Configure project settings and required input actions, then verify the mapped controls work in-game.

tasks.title: Install YARD and build the data layer
tasks.description: Install and configure YARD, create the Ship, Pilot, and Module registries, and verify stable IDs and module category indexing.

tasks.title: Create global run and sector utilities
tasks.description: Implement RunState and SectorSpace utilities for persistent run data, sector transitions, world state, and wrapped-space calculations.

tasks.title: Build the base ship and player ship
tasks.description: Implement BaseShip and PlayerShip with YARD-loaded stats, movement, shields, modules, groups, and required player visuals.

tasks.title: Build the six authored sector scenes
tasks.description: Create SectorRoot, then author Start, Patrol, Station, Nebula, Outpost, and Warp with their backgrounds, landmarks, encounters, and collisions. Configure the caravan, beacon, outpost, patrols, and reinforcements; verify each sector runs independently for layout testing and has quiet travel space.

tasks.title: Build the FTL-style system map
tasks.description: Create the six-node map, legal-route states, objective/side-quest/caravan information, and travel signal. Verify players can choose any legal connected destination from an uncleared sector.

tasks.title: Verify discrete world simulation and stale information
tasks.description: Verify ticks, caravan movement, reinforcements, and intel expiry advance only on sector transitions; keep last-known caravan information stale until sensors rediscover it.

tasks.title: Build the physical Warp Gate exit
tasks.description: Create the gate scene, collision, shader, sensor contact, and Interact behavior. Keep it out of the main-objective group. Verify entering Warp does not end the run; the player must find, reach, and interact with the gate. Confirm optional portal-art licensing before use.

tasks.title: Build the game coordinator and run flow
tasks.description: Create the persistent Game scene; load and replace sectors while preserving player and HUD; advance world state once per valid transition; connect the gate, lock map travel in Warp, and handle death/reset and completion.

tasks.title: Run the prototype completion checklist
tasks.description: Verify the guide’s full checklist, including YARD data, combat, drops, station, sensors, travel, persistent objectives, and wrapping. Compare a rush run with an explored/greedy run and confirm they produce meaningfully different Warp-sector difficulty.

tasks.title: Verify asset rights and credits
tasks.description: Resolve unknown terms for the enemy-ship sheet, Planetary Asset Pack, and Portal pack; retain required Super Pixel Effects and font credits/license files. Replace any asset without acceptable documented permission before release.

tasks.title: Create the warp-gate shader
tasks.description: Implement the gate’s shader visual and connect it to the WarpGate scene.

tasks.title: Finalize movement tuning
tasks.description: Tune ship handling after the prototype proves the movement design, before expanding ship content.

tasks.title: Expand the weapon framework
tasks.description: Add weapon types such as lasers, spread weapons, missiles, beams, or drones, including module interactions.

tasks.title: Add a contrasting second ship
tasks.description: Create a second ship with deliberately different handling to test ShipDefinition flexibility.

tasks.title: Add a second pilot
tasks.description: Add a pilot ability—such as time manipulation—to further test the pilot framework.

tasks.title: Build faction data and encounter preferences
tasks.description: Add faction relationships, visuals, encounter tables, AI styles, and equipment preferences.

tasks.title: Create reusable mission/objective resources
tasks.description: Replace prototype-specific objective flags with reusable mission and objective Resources.

tasks.title: Build sector-authoring tools
tasks.description: Create editor helpers for placing contacts, encounters, objective markers, and wrap-aware previews.

tasks.title: Improve seamless wrap presentation
tasks.description: Improve how toroidal sector edges are rendered after gameplay confirms wrapping is worth keeping.

tasks.title: Expand the shader library with performance budgets
tasks.description: Add sector-specific cosmic phenomena and define performance budgets for their effects.

tasks.title: Add a second solar system
tasks.description: Test whether the run structure scales to a new faction and environment combination.

tasks.title: Prototype a boss
tasks.description: Build a boss encounter after normal combat and buildcraft are working.

tasks.title: Add meta-progression and unlocks
tasks.description: Add ship, pilot, or module unlocks without relying on permanent stat inflation.

tasks.title: Build the HUD, minimap, compass, and Dev Mode toggle
tasks.description: Connect HUD information and objectives, sensor-limited contacts, minimap, compass, and a persistent Developer Console setting that defaults off. Verify the scanner improves minimap usefulness and the main objective remains represented outside sensor range. Retain the font license if using Pixelosopher.

tasks.title: Prove YARD-driven buildcraft
tasks.description: Test that YARD-loaded modules visibly change ship behavior and that category queries use YARD’s index rather than a separately maintained module list.

tasks.title: Build the timed intel side objective
tasks.description: Create the beacon and connect its availability, expiry, and reward to world ticks and RunState. Verify it can be completed early in Nebula but expires if the player advances the world too long elsewhere.
